title: Art. 12.1 — Annex 6 Part I - Operation of Aircraft: International Commercial Air Transport - Aeroplanes, Chapter 12, Article 12.1 - Assignment of cabin crew emergency duties, 12.1
content:
12.1 Assignment of emergency duties

12.1.1 The operator shall assign to each cabin crew member the necessary functions to be performed in the event of an emergency or in a situation requiring emergency evacuation.

12.1.2 The functions assigned shall be appropriate to the cabin crew member's competence and shall take into account the language abilities of the cabin crew members and the passengers to be carried.
